nameSources.rule: N1: kebab-to-Pascal with stem/suffix dedup; type names carry no version suffix (versions live in contract slots and codecs)
nameSources.executionClass: saga id bank-cash-payment-v1 (the durable plan face of that saga)

saga.source: knowledge: saga payload + strict runtime binding

results.source: knowledge: RESULT_KINDS frozen set (saga-hosts product); terminal set from the saga completion contract

participantsSource: knowledge: saga binding steps + payload participants in declaration order; N2 composes port member names from stepIds (camelCase), not ordinals; domain value types (BankPayment0PrepareInput and friends) keep knowledge-side names

portBindings.declaredIdNote: implementation identity strings keep the classic spelling (stable across member renames) — the handwritten composition root never retypes them

serializer.resultKindSlot: pb.operation (dedicated kind slot lands with the proto-family replacement, ruling T4)
serializer.source: judged: identifier allocation; knowledge: proto face schema

admission.contract: R2(b): in-memory coalescing; replies derived from durable state on re-invoke; caller owns ask timeout + retry; admission IO failure surfaces as 'admission unavailable', never as a denial

retry.source: judged slot (R1): consumed by the execution-face bridge (BankCashPaymentExecution)

coordinator.source: judged slots, carried from classic semantics

layout.discipline: L1: hand-balanced breaks, each frozen shape documented at its site
